title: 20世纪30年代弗莱舍工作室风格的动画
prompt: Transform this image into a 1930s animation storyboard in the style of Fleischer Studios. Use greyscale with expressive inky shading and rubber-hose limbs. Surround the scene with anthropomorphic objects, bouncy motion lines, and slapstick action. The overall tone should be jazzy, lively, and playful. Add hand-lettered sound effects and quirky dialogue signs.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro，将您的图像转换为 20 世纪 30 年代弗莱舍工作室风格的复古动画，呈现灰度橡胶管角色和生动闹剧动作，非常适合娱乐或广告领域创作怀旧卡通分镜、复古游戏素材或营销视觉。
